name: lens
description: Review a repo's changes in a pane: the changed files with editor-style diagnostics (pyright, ruff, tsc, eslint, terraform), a diff view, a git graph, commits and stashes, and pull request comments. Run /lens [folder] [base].

languageServers.title: Language servers first
languageServers.description: Ask the language servers (pyright, tsserver, terraform-ls) before the command-line checkers: answers come in milliseconds once they are warm. Off uses the command-line checkers alone.

ruff.title: Check Python with ruff
ruff.description: Lint the Python files of a change with ruff (run through uvx).

pyright.title: Check Python with pyright
pyright.description: Type-check the Python files of a change with pyright, through its language server or its command.

tsc.title: Check TypeScript with tsc
tsc.description: Type-check the TypeScript files of a change, through tsserver or the project's own tsc.

eslint.title: Check TypeScript with eslint
eslint.description: Lint the TypeScript files of a change with the project's own eslint, where it has one.

terraform.title: Check Terraform
terraform.description: Validate the Terraform files of a change with terraform-ls or terraform validate.

markNew.title: Mark new vs pre-existing
markNew.description: Check the base's version of each changed file too, so every problem is marked as brought by the change or already there. Off makes a scan quicker.

sidePadding.title: Side padding
sidePadding.description: The cells left clear at each side of the pane, 0 to 8.

keys.title: Keys shown
keys.description: main row + more… keeps the less-used keys in a box that m (or a) opens; all shown keeps that box open.

remember.title: Remember reviews
remember.description: Keep each repo's comparison and layout between sessions, so /lens picks it up where it was left, and offer the recent repos when /lens is run outside one.

cleanUp.title: Clean up when a session ends
cleanUp.description: Stop the language servers and delete the temporary exports of commits and the refs pull requests were fetched under. A review picked up again fetches what it needs.
